notes.title: New Legendary Update! ( 1.0.5 )
notes.notes:
Hear ye!

We are super excited to finally release the Legendary update for Knight Squad 2.

This one is a real content update as we are adding two new game modes and two new characters to the roster. Seasoned Knight Squad players will recognize the legendary knights making their comeback.

We hope you'll get to enjoy the new content with your friends. Don' forget to join our [url=www.discord.gg/chainsawesome]Discord[/url] to chat with us and find fellow players.

Stay Awesome!

----

Here's what you can expect from the Legendary Update :

TWO NEW MODES
Help your friends make the great escape in Jail Break and be the first to gather all the keys in Vault Raider.

TWO NEW KNIGHTS
Rise up to the challenge and unlock Sinister and Spike in the Knight Club.

Changes:
- In Gladiator mode, the crowned areas are no longer delimited by walls.
- In Juggernaut mode, slaying enemies without using the Juggernaut no longer awards points.
- In Soccer and Capture the Flag mode, teams in a draw will enter a tie breaker.
- Crazy Variations in Tourney mode are now locked for new players.
- While playing online, it is now possible to report players.
- It is no longer possible to edit the name of your online room.
- It is now possible to send the devs your logs to help in reporting bugs and issues.

Tweaks / Fixes:
- Fixed an issue that rendered a player invincible.
- Fixed an issue caused by joining two online rooms in a row.
- Fixed an issue causing a player to explode at the start of a round in Battle Royale
- Slightly improved the overall performance of the game

notes.title: New Shiny Update! ( 1.0.4 )
notes.notes:
Good morrow fair knights!

We are thrilled to be releasing our first big update for Knight Squad 2, just in time for the game's first month anniversary. 🎂

We built this update as fast as we could with a lot of quality of life improvements the players have been asking for.

It's just a first step for our content plan, we have a lot coming up for Knight Squad 2 ⚔

We hope you'll enjoy it and don't forget to join our [url=www.discord.gg/chainsawesome]Discord[/url] to chat with us and find fellow players.

Stay Awesome!

----

Here's what you can expect from the [b]Shiny Update[/b] :

[i]SHINY IS BACK![/i]
Check it out in the Knight Club

[i]Variants in Tourneys![/i]
Use the Variants menu or select Crazy Tourney for random variants every match

[i]Serial Kamikaze![/i]
You can now pick up a Kamikaze while under the effect of Kamikaze to reset it

Features:
- Added the possibility to disable bots in tourney mode
- Added action to promote someone to be the host in the knight selection UI.
- Added option to allow keyboard and mouse to be a separate player.
- Added option to make announcer texts smaller.

Tweaks:
- It is now possible to unlock maps when playing simple matches online
- When playing without bots, a leaving player will no longer be taken over by the AI. They will be removed from the game.
- If no enemy player is left when playing without bots, the players will be brought back to the lobby.
- Added a UI to let players know they are waiting for the host to choose the map/tourney options.
- Added game mode description tooltip for non host waiting players.
- Changed the sort order of lobbies to show them by best region -> password status -> in game status -> player count
- Added power up spawn speed in the variants UI visualizer

Fixes:
- Fixed drill icon on crystal rush spawners
- Fixed 32:9 aspect ratio (that is one crazy big screen)
- Fixed an issue where the local player would pull an Xbox One wireless dongle disconnecting multiple controllers at once.

notes.title: Knight Squad 2 is now AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Good morrow!

What a great morrow indeed! Knight Squad 2 is now available!!

Thank you for your interest in our game and I hope you and your friends will have a blast playing. Knight Squad 2 supports local, online cross-platform and mixed multiplayer.

Fun thing about Knight Squad 2 is that your friends can all join your online lobby for free by using Knight Squad 2 Trials. Gather them up!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1529560/Knight_Squad_2_Trials]Knight Squad 2 Trials[/url]

If your friends are not available, remember to join our Discord community to find other players to battle with ( or against ).

[url=discord.gg/chainsawesome]Chainsawesome Discord[/url]

Lastly, if you do choose to purchase and play Knight Squad 2, we thank you wholeheartedly and we kindly ask for you to leave a Steam Review. This is really helpful to us.

Stay Awesome!

notes.title: Knight Squad 2 arrives on April 14th!
notes.notes:
Good morrow humble knights!

It is with great joy that we are announcing today that Knight Squad 2 will release on Steam on April 14th. And we're talking full release, not Early Access.

All 13 game modes, 97 battle arenas, and 16 knights will all be there to unlock and play with your friends.

If it has not been done already, we greatly encourage you to wishlist the game on here and join our gamer community on [url=www.discord.gg/chainsawesome]Discord[/url].

But that's not the only news we have for you all. We are also releasing a new way to play Knight Squad 2 for free today, Knight Squad 2 Trials.

[url=https://bit.ly/ks2trials]Knight Squad 2 Trials[/url]

This is a free game and you'll get to keep it forever. It has the most popular of all game modes, Battle Royale as well as 3 battle arenas and all the gameplay variants. 

Once Knight Squad 2 is out on April 14th, you can use Trials to play with your friends who own the full game and consequently, enjoy the entire content of Knight Squad 2, for free. We really want to make it as easy as possible for friends to play Knight Squad 2 together.

Please give Knight Squad 2 Trials a spin today and leave a review if you feel like it, this will help us greatly.

Stay Awesome!

notes.title: A new Demo for the "Games from Quebec" event
notes.notes:
Good morrow!

Knight Squad 2 will be once again, part of a digital event on Steam. Our new ( and last ) demo will be featured during the "[b]Games From Quebec[/b]" alongside a ton of great games from our beloved part of the world.

If you haven't found the time to try our demo or our beta in the last few months, please find some time during the weekend because it will disappear on Monday, February 1st, and never come back. That's right, we're getting ready for a full release.

This new demo features 4 games modes :
[list]
[*]Battle Royale
[*]Juggernaut
[*]Payload
[*]Gladiator
[/list]

as well as local and online multiplayer : )

Join our fans on [url=www.discord.gg/chainsawesome]Discord[/url]
And don't forget to put the game on your wishlist!

Stay Awesome!

notes.title: Join the Knight Squad 2 Beta!
notes.notes:
Good morrow fair gents!

We are psyched to be opening the [b]Knight Squad 2 Beta[/b] today. These 16 days of testing will be one of the last ( if not the last ) time you’ll get to play Knight Squad 2 before its release.

Here’s the content we got for you:
[list]
[*] Battle Royale
[*] Domination
[*] Minion Master
[*] Painter
[*] An additional forest map for each mode
[*] 2 characters to unlock
[*] Cross-platform online multiplayer
[/list]

While this is way more content than in the demos, it’s still just a fraction of the whole content we are planning for the full release.

If you haven’t already, please wishlist Knight Squad 2 on Steam then request access to the playtest via the new button on the Steam Page. You’ll instantly get to download the Beta.

Then head to our [url=www.discord.gg/chainsawesome]Discord[/url] to chat with the community and directly with us!

We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on this Beta.

Stay Awesome!

notes.notes:
Good morrow fair knights and fair peasants,

We are very ecstatic to take part in the Steam Autumn Festival with a very special demo of Knight Squad 2 starting on October 7th.

You'll get to taste:
[list]
[*] 4 game modes
[*] 10 battle arenas
[*] Local and online multiplayer
[*] Perfectly silly weapons and power-ups
[*] Slippery floors and exploding bodies
[/list]

You can play with your friends online and invite them through Steam or via our very fancy Discord invite system. If you are looking for other fun folks to play with, please join our dashing [url=www.discord.gg/chainsawesome]Discord Community[/url].

The full version of Knight Squad 2 is set to release in Early 2021 and will contain 13 game modes and more maps than you can count! ( can you count to 100? )

If you think the game looks kinda fun, please move your cursor to the "Add to Wishlist" button and press firmly on the left button of your mouse device, once.

We are very eager to get your feedback on this demo.

Stay awesome!

notes.title: Try the PAX Online Knight Squad 2 Demo today!
notes.notes:
Good morrow fair gents!

Knight Squad 2 is taking part in the biggest and boldest online gaming event of the year, PAX Online.

This means that our PC demo is once again open to all and for a period of 9 whole days.

[h3]Demo Content[/h3]

[list]
[*] 3 game modes with their team variations ( Domination, Payload, Battle Royale )
[*] All ( current ) new weapons
[*] All ( current ) variants ( you have the try slippery floors )
[*] Online multiplayer ( with improved performance and Discord invites )
[/list]

This is still some sort of a "beta-demo" and the experience might have some rough edges. If you encounter any problem or if you have any suggestions, please use our [url=www.discord.gg/chainsawesome]Discord Community[/url] or the Steam Forums.

We hope you and your friends will enjoy the content of the Knight Squad 2 Demo.

Stay awesome!

The very first PC demo of Knight Squad 2 is now available worldwide as part of the Indie Arena Booth of Gamescom Online.

You have until August 31st at 9:00 am EST to download and try the Demo. Following that, the Demo will be removed until further notice so we can keep working on it and surprise you with a shinier version in the future.

[b]Demo Content[/b]

[list]
[*] 3 game modes ( Capture the Grail, Battle Royale, Payload )
[*] 8 knights
[*] All 20 weapons and power-ups
[*] ONLINE
[/list]

Keep in mind that this is sort of a "beta-demo" and the experience might have some rough edges. If you encounter any problem or if you have any suggestions, please use our Discord Community or the Steam Forums.

We hope you and your friends will enjoy the content of the Knight Squad 2 Demo.

Stay awesome!

notes.title: Knight Squad 2 Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This is a very exciting milestone for us! 

On August 27th, as part of the Gamescom Online's Indie Arena Booth, we will make a demo of Knight Squad 2 available to everyone for a period of 3 days only. 

The demo is but a small taste of all the content we have planned but we're convinced it's enough to have a blast during this short time window. 

[h3]Demo content[/h3]

[list]
[*] 3 game modes with their team variations
[*] All ( current ) new weapons
[*] All ( current ) variants ( you have the try slippery floors )
[*] Online multiplayer
[/list]

In the meantime, we invite you to join our Discord community to meet the other fans and prepare to battle it out on August 27th.

Looking forward to see you all on the battlefied.

Stay awesome!
